## Environment

- AI/model:
- Interface/runtime:
- Protocol version/commit:
- Relevant skill(s), if known:

## Real task

What was the user actually trying to achieve?

## Observed failure

What did the AI do that was materially wrong, premature, unsupported, overbuilt, incomplete, or misleading?

## Why it matters

What decision, action, evidence, cost, risk, or outcome changed because of the failure?

## Minimal reproduction

Provide the smallest prompt/context needed to reproduce the behavior. Remove secrets and private data.

## Expected behavior

What should the AI have done instead?

## Evidence

Include output excerpts, screenshots, logs, repository state, or other evidence when available.

## Candidate layer

If known: router / skill / canonical Protocol / enforcement / eval / unknown.

Do not propose a new rule merely because one wording looks nicer. Prefer a real repeated failure or a clearly decision-relevant gap.
